context:
Goal: a holdings value report that counts what you actually received.
Problem (risk): the units received live in the mailaudit ledger outside this repo, which holds names; reading it widens what the lane sees.
Based on (notes): the coordinator's notes on the holdings value report lane.
The report can still ship without it, labeled 'units received unknown'.

options.how: The lane reads the ledger outside the repo for units received.
options.label: Lane reads the mailaudit ledger
options.lose: The lane reads a file with names in it, outside this repo.

options.gain: Exact counts, and no names reach the lane.
options.how: You give product id and units received only, with no names.
options.label: You give an extract
options.lose: A few minutes of your time to make the extract.

options.how: The report says units received unknown.
options.label: Ship it as unknown
options.lose: The report cannot say how much of each buy you still hold.

ref: item 21 (holdings sales export), mailaudit holdings value report
title: Where should the holdings report get units received?
why: Exact counts without names leaving the ledger.
